categories.name: Fades
categories.note: Opacity does the work, sometimes with a little scale or blur

categories.name: Slides
categories.note: Views move along an axis, like going forward and back

categories.name: Scale & 3D
categories.note: Views grow, shrink or turn over

categories.name: Reveals
categories.note: A mask or a panel uncovers the next view

categories.name: Choreography
categories.note: Several parts move together, or one after another

transitions.name: Crossfade
transitions.desc: The old view fades out while the new one fades in over it. The default for page changes, and what the View Transitions API does when you add nothing else.
transitions.prompt: crossfade between routes, 200ms ease-out, using the View Transitions API

transitions.name: Fade through
transitions.aka: Sequential fade, fade out then in
transitions.desc: The old view fades out first, then the new one fades in while scaling up slightly. Use it when the two views aren't related, like switching tabs in a bottom bar.
transitions.prompt: fade-through transition: old view fades out, then new view fades in and scales from 92% to 100%

transitions.name: Blur fade
transitions.desc: Views blur as they fade, so the change feels soft, like a camera refocusing. Popular on landing pages and for text that swaps in place.
transitions.prompt: blur fade transition, outgoing view blurs to 8px and fades, incoming view sharpens from blur as it fades in

transitions.name: Push
transitions.desc: The new view slides in from the side and pushes the old one out. Both move together. Used for carousels, onboarding steps and wizards.
transitions.prompt: push slide transition, new page slides in from the right and pushes the old page out to the left

transitions.name: Slide over
transitions.desc: The new view slides over the old one, which shifts back a little and dims. Reads as moving deeper into a stack, like opening a detail screen on a phone.
transitions.how: transform + shadow on the incoming view, dim the outgoing view
transitions.prompt: iOS-style stack navigation: new screen slides over from the right with a shadow, previous screen shifts left 30% and dims

transitions.name: Shared axis
transitions.desc: Both views shift a short distance in the same direction while they fade. Gentler than a full push, and the direction still tells you forward from back.
transitions.prompt: shared axis X transition: outgoing view slides 15% left and fades out, incoming view slides in from 15% right and fades in

transitions.name: Zoom
transitions.aka: Scale transition, zoom in, scale and fade
transitions.desc: The old view grows and fades away while the new one scales up into place. Feels like stepping into the content.
transitions.prompt: zoom transition, old view scales up to 115% and fades out while the new view scales from 85% to 100% and fades in

transitions.name: Flip
transitions.desc: The view turns over like a card to show its back. Used for flashcards, pricing toggles and front/back details.
transitions.prompt: 3D card flip on the Y axis with perspective, the back face is hidden until it turns past 90 degrees

transitions.name: Circle reveal
transitions.aka: Iris, radial reveal, theme toggle reveal
transitions.desc: The new view grows out of a circle that starts at one point, often the button that was clicked. The classic dark-mode toggle effect.
transitions.prompt: circular clip-path reveal that expands from the clicked button, using the View Transitions API

transitions.name: Wipe
transitions.aka: Linear wipe, clip reveal, edge wipe
transitions.desc: A straight edge sweeps across and replaces the old view with the new one. Neither view moves; only the edge does.
transitions.prompt: linear wipe transition from left to right using clip-path inset

transitions.name: Curtain
transitions.aka: Overlay wipe, panel sweep, page cover
transitions.desc: A solid panel sweeps in to cover the page, the content swaps while it's hidden, then the panel sweeps away. Common on agency and portfolio sites.
transitions.how: an overlay element with transform, swap content at full cover
transitions.prompt: curtain page transition: a solid brand-colored panel sweeps in from the left, the page swaps behind it, then the panel exits to the right

transitions.name: Shape reveal
transitions.aka: Mask reveal, logo mask, shape transition
transitions.desc: The new view shows through a shape that grows until it fills the screen. Any shape works: a diamond, a logo or a letter.
transitions.prompt: diamond shape mask reveal that grows from the center until it covers the page

transitions.name: Shared element
transitions.aka: Container transform, hero transition, morph, magic move
transitions.desc: One element, like a card's image, travels and resizes into its place on the next view, while everything else fades. The eye follows it, so the two views feel connected.
transitions.prompt: shared element transition: the card thumbnail morphs into the detail page hero image using view-transition-name, other content crossfades

transitions.name: Stagger
transitions.desc: The new view's parts arrive one after another instead of all at once, each with a small delay. Guides the eye down the page.
transitions.prompt: staggered entrance, list items fade in and rise 8px one after another with a 60ms delay between each
